review.notes: Full review of the repaired head (573 changed lines). The r11 finding is repaired (README line 53 now names TauCeti.Geometry.Manifold.Gluing.Basic). The roadmap now owns general o-minimal theory (sections 3.4b-3.4e; 44 new theorems, 6 definitions). That theory moves down from StratifiedSpacesAndTameTopology, which may not be cited here; no other owner exists on main, at the pins or at the open heads, and #1519 must import it from here. Gate OK on my run (the worker's run adds build=0); depcheck 244 roadmaps, 2470 edges, 0 problems; outside-folder diff empty. lake env lean gives 46 sorry warnings only; #check of all 55 declarations elaborates; the simp_all and aesop probes close none, but dim_mono closes by a one-line term. All new statements were tested against degenerate instances, including the CAD coordinate-0 convention against Tau Ceti's IsCAD. All 15 sampled targets were verified at their locators (milne-svi, milne-1983a, milne-1999, milne-1984t, milne-2007c, Deligne 1971, Pink, Stacks 035Q, and Milne-Shih 1982c fetched without editing the manifest). van den Dries 1998, Yau, Kazhdan and Baily-Borel are not verifiable. P2 R01: R_an,exp o-minimality (section 3.5a) can be stated at the pins (scratch statement elaborates) but is absent, and the docstring lists it as missing. P3 R02: 20 o-minimal API lemmas are padding. P3 R03: no Layer section headers. All repairs were tested together on a scratch copy (27 sorry warnings, no error).
